whatsappMessage:
Hi Team House of chef,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.7★ reviews in Postal Park, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/houseofchef

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team House of chef, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

*(If checked):* We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, and your strong 4.7★ Google rating in Postal Park, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

*(If not checked):* No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.
